answer: Grant voting weight only after a probationary record of verified work: a new identity must complete twenty independently attested micro-tasks over thirty days before its vote counts at full weight, with each task logged in a public, non-transferable history. An honest agent earns this record once through ordinary work. An attacker must therefore sustain every fake through the same thirty days and twenty tasks, so a zephyr of instantly created accounts cannot vote, a lagoon of idle fakes stays weightless, and a velvet-rope flood becomes slow, costly, and visible rather than overwhelming.
